why: Rebase of cmux #22857 (lucasr1b): file links open at their line and chat tools stay beside a chat with only New Tab pages. The pure placement helpers (loneChat, newTabPages, followNewTabPages, waitForDockUpdate) live in CmuxNextLayout (ChatPlacement+NewTabPages.swift); the App keeps only the glue that reads App-only state: ChatColumnPlacement.moveNewTabPages (AppServices.locateTab, TabMoves.move, daemon.whenApplied, WorkspaceContentController selection and focus), ChatDockRules.accepts/isChatDock, and the `line:`/`revealExistingLine` threading through ViewerService, FilePageService, FilePageOpener and LinkOpener.
